title: Anthropic signs 20-year lease at TeraWulf's Kentucky campus (~$19B)

sources.quote: The lease is expected to generate approximately $19 billion of contracted revenue over the initial lease term.

explain: Anthropic, the maker of Claude, signed a 20-year lease directly with TeraWulf for about 401 megawatts at the Justified Data campus in Hawesville, Kentucky. TeraWulf expects about $19 billion in rent, with first capacity in late 2027.
